title: Supported GitHub Actions runtimes
summary: Pinned the first-party CI and artifact Actions to reviewed Node 24 releases while preserving the existing test, package, and deployment gates.
changes: Pinned checkout, Node setup, artifact upload, and artifact download Actions to immutable reviewed commit SHAs with auditable version comments.
Preserved exact-revision packaging, pull-request deployment exclusion, deployment-control authentication, backup, activation, rollback, and health verification behavior.
affected_areas: Continuous integration, release packaging, and deployment orchestration
version_rationale: A backward-compatible patch release updating trusted workflow dependencies without changing application behavior.
validation: Workflow contracts require the exact reviewed pins and reject the deprecated references; pull-request CI verifies the complete matrix without admitting deployment.
known_limitations: Immutable Action pins require a separate reviewed update when a future supported release is adopted.
rollback: The preceding workflow remains application-compatible; reverting the workflow commit restores its prior Action references without changing application data or schema.
provenance: Defined by the supported GitHub Actions runtime work for MyAPES Account issue #31.
